title: Clock
description: One countdown, with its provenance attached. The provenance fields are required by the schema so that a caller (UI or agent) physically cannot receive a number without its citation. See docs/REVIEW.md H2.

clock_key.description: Canonical clock list. The engine and the UI both read this enum; see docs/REVIEW.md B8, which is the finding this enum exists to close.

label.description: Human name, in the caller's locale. 'Unemployment days', not 'gap accumulation metric'.

kind.description: consumption = days used out of a ceiling. deadline = days until a date. window = an open/close interval.

applicable.description: false when this clock does not run for this person. Someone in cap-gap is in F-1 status with a pending petition, so the six-year meter has not started and AC21 has nothing to extend. A clock that has not started must never be rendered as zero. See docs/REVIEW.md B11.

not_applicable_reason.description: Why it is not running, in the caller's locale. Required reading when applicable is false: 'not in H-1B status; the six-year meter has not started' is an answer, and zero is not.

denominator.description: The ceiling, for kind=consumption. 90 or 150 for opt_unemployment.

window_days.description: Length of the window itself. Distinct from days_remaining; conflating them is docs/REVIEW.md F3.

derived.description: true when the number is our arithmetic over a regulation rather than a figure stated in one. ac21_365 is derived. See docs/REVIEW.md E5.

derivation.description: Shown to the user when derived=true. The arithmetic, in words.

authority.description: Widened from the spec's three values to include SEVP guidance; see docs/REVIEW.md E3.

verified.description: false means verified_by is unset in the rules table. The UI MUST render the warning band. Never suppress this.

superseded.description: Present when the governing rule supersedes an earlier version AND that earlier version was in force during a period relevant to this user. Drives the strikethrough. Chain-driven, not time-window-driven; see docs/REVIEW.md A2.

delta_days.description: Days gained or lost versus the prior rule. Positive means the current rule is better for this user.

change_reason.description: Why this differs from yesterday's evaluation. Three cases, not two; see docs/REVIEW.md B6. Derived from inputs_hash (facts) and rule_id (law) independently.

corpus_context.description: Real-world context from the corpus, where the statutory number and the observed number differ enough to change what someone should do. Present on ac21_365: the statute needs a filing pending 365 days, and the median certified PERM takes 462. Carries its own source block; never inferred.

then.description: A RUNNING clock must carry provenance. This is the citation contract, in the schema.
